entities.name: Jameh Mosque of Qom
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Jāmeh Mosque of Qom, also known as the Atiq Jameh Mosque of Qom, is a Friday mosque (jāmeh), located in the downtown area of the city of Qom, in the province of Qom, Iran. It is one of the oldest mosques in Qom.
